reason: The primitive hexagonal cell, Z=1, and the Ti/Bi average framework are strongly supported by complete indexing and a good extracted-intensity match, but the exact submitted structure is not sufficiently established. No comparable whole-pattern Rwp was supplied, and the trajectory refined extracted peak areas rather than demonstrating a whole-profile fit. More importantly, the imposed P-6m2 realization places N 2.75-2.78 A from Ti, which is chemically questionable for a nitride, while a lower-symmetry displacement of the single N atom gives a marginally better extracted-intensity fit and more strongly Ti-N-bonded placements remain reasonably competitive. Those lower-symmetry/light-element alternatives were not instantiated and compared, so the submitted symmetry and N coordinate remain unresolved even though the cell and heavy-atom framework are convincing.
